alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 22 at 2:33PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
alerts.description:
At 233 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from near Romeo to 8 miles south of Antonito.
Movement was northeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Alamosa, San Luis Valley Airport, Manassa, Sanford, La Jara,
Antonito, Romeo, Alamosa East, Jaroso, Conejos, Bountiful, and Ortiz.

alerts.headline: Flood Watch issued October 22 at 2:13PM MDT until October 23 at 6:00PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...The eastern San Juan Mountains and Upper Rio Grande Valley.

* WHEN...Through Friday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Ample sub-tropcial moisture will bring periods of moderate to
heavy rain across the area from tonight into Friday morning
before winding down Friday afternoon.
- The eastern San Juan Mountains and Upper Rio Grande Valley.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

alerts.title: US 160 Pagosa Springs Reconstruction-147598
alerts.description: Between US 84 and Pike Drive (Pagosa Springs) from Mile Point 144.3 to Mile Point 141.8. Road construction. Starting October 22, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 22, 2026 at about 6:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 22, 7:00AM - October 22, 6:00PM Comment: Harman Park & Piedra Road-Work is underway at this intersection of US 160. Working hours will be intermittent day and night so motorists should plan for potential delays, Monday-Saturday. Please allow extra time to get through the work zone. Safety benefits of this work includes pedestrian safety upgrades and ADA accessibility improvements. Expect lane shifts and up to 15-minute delays. Crews will switch two-way traffic into the eastbound lanes, perform temporary striping operations and begin asphalt milling in the westbound lanes. Parking will not be permitted on US 160 and vehicles will be towed at the owner's expense. Westbound lane closures, 10’ width and 75’ length restrictions will remain in place 24/7 through end of 2026. Work is weather-dependent. For questions contact the project team at 970-335-9230 or Pagosa160reconstruction@gmail.com Project Webpage: www.codot.gov/projects/us160pagosasprings
